opening.argument: The speaker promotes participation in MMM Global by presenting extraordinarily high passive returns, stating that participants may make 100 percent per month, or 20 to 30 percent by doing nothing. He then invites viewers to try the program and says he will provide his link. Although he calls it a Ponzi scheme and cautions viewers not to contribute more than they can afford to lose, those qualifications do not undo the active solicitation. He discloses that he has already invested $500 and may invest more, using his own participation as supporting context. The overall communication therefore directs viewers toward joining an investment pool while presenting highly attractive returns, rather than functioning as a detached warning.
